neighbours.label: the word opening a parenthetical right after a name and comma ('Stupak, and', 'Kikorian, as', 'The Tsar, however')
fire: Senator Reed, and the members who backed her, knew it.
Hartman, as the man behind the plan, spoke first.
Gandhi, and those who marched with him, walked on.
Bell, as head of the lab, said no.
The Pope, however, refused to go.
Marie, as the eldest child, stayed behind.
Judge Ford, and the two clerks with him, left early.
quiet: Hartman spoke first about the plan.
Gandhi walked on with those who marched.
Bell said no as head of the lab.
Marie stayed behind as the eldest child.
Judge Ford left early with the two clerks.

notes: French 'je' after 'Cette scène,' read only 0.13 in a probe; ' c'est' read 0.44. Near misses are not all the same length, because they drop the parenthetical, but they keep the words where possible.
